column2: TESTING ONLY. Show the ATLA Dev Test buttons.
Hide the ATLA Dev Test buttons.
Show Royal Authority, the treasury, tributaries, the unity law and the active Avatar burdens.

Make yourself a restored, non-puppet Earth King under the States law, as the base restoration chain would. The base law event then makes Earth realms tributaries. A day later Royal Authority is set to 65 and the treasury gains 250.
Switch between a puppet Earth King (the Grand Secretariat spends the treasury and answers pleas) and a restored one.
Set Royal Authority to the next plea band: 20 (weak), 45 (steady), 70 (strong).
Royal Authority moves to the next band: below 30 becomes 45, 30 to 59 becomes 70, 60 or more becomes 20.
Add 200 gold to the treasury of Ba Sing Se (it never holds more than 1,000).
Test: Run Ba Sing Se Year
Run the yearly Ba Sing Se update now: income, works, the Grand Secretariat, the reach, breakaways and AI pleas. Check game.log for the result.
Trace which tributaries are connected to Ba Sing Se. Every tributary is written to game.log as connected or out of reach.
A random Earth realm pleads with Ba Sing Se now, without needing a war. A puppet king's Grand Secretariat answers in his place.
Give the world one of the five Avatar's Legacy burdens now.
Run the yearly Avatar's Legacy pulse now: burdens act on the world, the champion search, the AI Avatar's confrontation.

Royal Authority: [global_royalAuthority.GetValue]. Unity law tier: [global_atxd_unity.GetValue] (0 Disunion, 1 Territories, 2 States, 3 Monarchism).
